claims.evidence: Each raw file is one SILAC mixture of one light culture plus the heavy reference. Supplementary Table 1 (and the identical sample name stored in each raw-file header) names each file "RB<n>-NT/<condition> <time>", e.g. OETCD140606_01.raw = "RB1-NT/FBS 10min". One light source per file = one physical culture (condition x time x replicate RB1-4). All 40 runs are annotated. The authors' ISO labels are kept in the light source names next to the inhibitor; the ISO map is an owner-accepted inference (see the treatment claim).

claims.value: Capan-1 heavy vehicle reference RB<n> <10 minute|24 hour> unstimulated, aliquot in <run>
claims.evidence: Supplementary Methods: "Light and heavy cells were pre-treated respectively with inhibitors or ... vehicule (DMSO) during 1h, then stimulated or not for 10min or 24h with 2% dialyzed FBS. After 10min and 24h of FBS stimulation, heavy cells and light cells were ... lysed. Four biological replicates were sampled for each time point. These biological replicates were performed on four weeks." Methods: "For each biological replicate, light lysates were mixed with the same heavy lysates". Fig. 1 legend: "heavy vehicle condition is a technical replicate that is added in each run". Fig. 1C (HAL PDF p.31) shows the heavy/vehicle dish "+FBS 2%: -" in both the 10 min and the 24 h frames. PRIDE: heavy = "starved untreated cells", normalised "between each biological replicates at the two time of treatment". So there are 8 heavy cultures (RB1-RB4 x 10 min/24 h), each mixed with all five light conditions of its replicate and time point: FBS, LY, ISO1, ISO2, ISO3. That gives five runs per heavy culture and one source name per run (validation.md:22-23); the five names of one culture are aliquots of one heavy lysate. ISO3 runs (OETCD140618_*) and ISO1/2 runs (OETCD140614_*) carry later LC-MS acquisition dates than the FBS/LY runs (OETCD140606_*; raw creation dates 2014-06-06 to 2014-06-22). Acquisition date says nothing about culture identity, and the "same heavy lysates" sentence makes the heavy lysate shared within each replicate (and time point). The ISO runs therefore use the same RB x time heavy cultures, with their own per-run source names.

claims.value: light = treated/stimulated condition (study sample); heavy = vehicle reference (reference)
claims.evidence: Paper Fig. 1C/D legend and Supplementary Methods: "Light and heavy cells were pre-treated respectively with inhibitors or their accordingly diluted vehicule (DMSO)". PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol: "median of heavy samples (starved untreated cells)" and ratios are Light area / Heavy area. msf quant method: SILAC 2plex (Arg10, Lys8), channel 1 Light, channel 2 Heavy (heavier m/z). Data check: for every inhibitor run, log2(L/H run) - log2(L/H FBS run of the same replicate) correlates positively with the authors' Table S2 log2 values (all 32 run/column pairs computed over LY and ISO runs, 30 positive; for the annotated LY runs r=+0.13 at 10 min and +0.15 at 24 h against the LY column). A swapped map would give negative correlations.

claims.value: FBS -> untreated / dimethyl sulfoxide / not available; LY -> LY294002 10 uM; ISO1 -> A66 5 uM; ISO2 -> TGX-221 500 nM; ISO3 -> AS-252424 5 uM
claims.evidence: Doses and roles: paper Fig. 1 legend and Supplementary Methods ("10uM LY-294002 (pan-inh), 5uM A66 (PI3Kalpha inhibitor), 500nM TGX-221 (PI3Kbeta inhibitor), 5uM AS-252424 (PI3Kgamma inhibitor) or their accordingly diluted vehicle (DMSO)"). LY294002 = CHEBI:65329 (OLS). A66, TGX-221 and AS-252424 have no CHEBI/NCIT/EFO term (OLS search), so the paper spellings are used. FBS = vehicle + FBS = template control value "untreated" (batch rule 4); DMSO dose not stated. ISO1/ISO2/ISO3 -> A66/TGX-221/AS-252424 is an INFERENCE ACCEPTED BY THE OWNER (decision of 2026-11-11, this dataset only); no source states it in words. Evidence: (a) Supplementary Table 2 groups peptides under "PI3Kalpha / PI3Kbeta / PI3Kgamma / pan-PI3K selective peptides". By the authors' 0.7/1.4 thresholds the alpha group is changed only in ISO1 (56/58 at 10 min, 35/35 at 24 h), the beta group only in ISO2 (25/25, 30/31), the gamma group only in ISO3 (82/86, 70/71) and the pan group in LY (75/76, 47/48) (iso_check.txt). (b) The paper names the alpha-inh-selective targets RACGAP1, IRS2 and STAT3, the beta-inh target RB1 and the gamma-inh targets CTNND1 and JUP; in Table S2 these sit in the ISO1-changed (alpha), ISO2-changed (beta) and ISO3-changed (gamma) groups respectively. (c) The paper lists the inhibitors in alpha, beta, gamma order throughout. (d) Per-run msf ratios agree weakly: the matching Table S2 column correlates best in 7 of 8 runs (r 0.12-0.32; orientation_*.txt).

Supplementary Methods: "SILAC RPMI medium deficient in L-Lysine and L-Arginine ... supplemented with 10% dialyzed FBS"; NCIT:C178973 (OLS).

Main text Methods: "SILAC samples (TiO2 enriched peptides) were resuspended ... and analyzed by nano-LC-MS/MS ... All 40 mass spectrometry proteomic files have been deposited to ProteomeXchange". The Supplementary Methods LC-MS paragraph says "SILAC samples (TiO2 enriched peptides and flowthrough peptides)". But the 40 deposited files are exactly the 40 condition x time x replicate names of Supplementary Table 1, one per sample, none named as flow-through. Each searched run yields about 2000-3000 quantified phosphopeptides (msf_quant.py on 10 runs), as expected for TiO2 eluates. So no flow-through run is deposited. EFO:0010806 is a descendant of EFO:0009090 (OLS hierarchicalAncestors).

limitations: ISO1/ISO2/ISO3 -> A66/TGX-221/AS-252424 (24 runs: OETCD140614_02-_35, OETCD140618_01-_16) is an inference from Supplementary Table 2. The owner accepted it on 2026-11-11 for this dataset only; no source states it in words. The PhD thesis, which might state it, was unreachable. Evidence is in the characteristics[treatment] claim. BLOCKED.md section PXD008410 records the decision.

Heavy reference: 8 heavy cultures (RB1-RB4 x 10 min / 24 h), unstimulated, each shared by the five condition runs of its replicate and time point (including the later-acquired ISO runs). This rests on the "same heavy lysates" sentence, the Supplementary Methods lysis sentence, the Fig. 1C scheme and the PRIDE normalisation text. The Fig. 1 legend phrase "heavy vehicle condition is a technical replicate that is added in each run" is read as "one heavy culture added to every run of its replicate and time point".
characteristics[dose] for the DMSO vehicle is not available ("accordingly diluted vehicle"; no concentration given).

parse_sdrf validate-sdrf warnings (exit 0): A66, TGX-221 and AS-252424 have no ontology term, and "untreated" in characteristics[treatment] is not an NCIT/EFO term but is the control value the template prescribes. Capan-1 is not matched in CLO/BTO/EFO, whose labels are "Capan-1 cell", "CAPAN-1 cell" and "Capan1"; the Cellosaurus name is kept and the line is identified by CVCL_0237.
